title: Homily on the Burial of Christ's Body
edition: PG 41-43; Homilia in divini corporis sepulturam (Khazarzar)
author: Epiphanius of Salamis
blurb: A vivid reflection on Christ's burial, Joseph of Arimathea, and the silence of the earth as God rests in the flesh.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Epiphanius of Salamis’s Homilia in divini corporis sepulturam — new OET from PG 41–43 Greek (Khazarzar). Modern English syncs (incl. Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill) were not used as wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew densify. SERIES CLOSEOUT.
